description: Main index file for the Home module in SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering the dashboard page, managing user preferences for dashlets and pages, loading necessary resources, and rendering the dashboard UI with Smarty templates.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the dashboard UI.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a dashlet should be displayed based on user permissions and module visibility.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the dashlet cache if not already present.

methods.name: getChartResources
methods.description: Retrieves resources needed for rendering charts.

methods.name: getMySugarChartResources
methods.description: Retrieves resources specific to MySugar charts.
